verified_claims.claim: FoTO1在脂质体中对taxadiene-4(5)-epoxide的kcat = 69 ± 5 sec⁻¹, Km = 30 ± 7 µM（7个底物浓度4–200 µM）
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文物理页4，Results第二段；Figure 1 caption (d)
verified_claims.evidence: FoTO1 turns over its epoxide substrate with a kcat of 69 ± 5 sec-1 and a Km of 30 ± 7 µM (Figure 1c; Supplementary Fig 3)

verified_claims.claim: FoTO1催化失活突变体D149A与Y60A在N. benthamiana中与T5αH/TDS共表达仍使taxadien-5α-ol提高~3倍
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文物理页6，'FoTO1 has additional non-catalytic properties in planta'段落
verified_claims.evidence: expression of the FoTO1 catalytic mutants D149 or Y60A in combination with T5αH, TDS, and boost enzymes in planta resulted in a reproducible 3-fold increase in taxadien-5α-ol

verified_claims.claim: TurboID-FoTO1前100富集内源蛋白中36个ER、16个质体表面、12个细胞核；TurboID-only对照仅4个ER
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文物理页7与Figure 4d caption (物理页18)
verified_claims.evidence: thirty-six out of the top hundred enriched proteins localizing to the ER... sixteen of the top one hundred significantly enriched TurboID-FoTO1 hits were localized to the surface of the plastid; only four of the top hundred proteins labelled by the TurboID control were ER-localized; nucleus (12)

verified_claims.claim: T10βH-Myc共沉淀可显著拉下T5αH (~7%)与FoTO1 (~15%)；T10βH–T5αH互作不依赖FoTO1
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文物理页8，'FoTO1 participates in an enzyme complex'段落
verified_claims.evidence: Pulldown of T10βH led to the statistically significant co-pulldown of T5αH (7%) and FoTO1 (15%) (Figure 3k-l)... T10βH-T5αH interaction occurs even in the absence of FoTO1

verified_claims.claim: FoTO1在forskolin（11-oxo-13R-manoyl oxide，3-fold）、momilactone（syn-paramidine-6-ol，2–3-fold）、gibberellin（GA12，2–3-fold）途径中均提高产量；AtFoTO同源物无显著作用；citrus limonoid三萜途径无显著增产
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文物理页10，'FoTO1 acts on diverse diterpene pathways'段落
verified_claims.evidence: there is a 3-fold increase in the production of the forskolin intermediate 11-oxo-13R-manoyl oxide. Addition of the catalytically inactive FoTO1-D149A leads to the same 3-fold increase but addition of a FoTO1 homolog from A. thaliana does not... we saw a similar 2 to 3-fold increase in yield (Figure 5b)... Addition of FoTO1 to a triterpene limonoid pathway, however, did not lead to an observed yield increase
